decisions.because: ROADMAP typed-axiom step: signal target selection used diagnostic strings as protection identity. Typed constructors and exhaustive SourceRole separate identity from wording while preserving current policy and messages. A native mutation restoring string-based target selection fails the matching-diagnostic assertion; compile controls require E0004 in source_role for a new variant, with explicit-role positive controls.

statement: Protection identity and diagnostic text are separate. For a protected single-address signal source, LocalAddress and HomeNetwork select the destination; every other declared protection role refuses redirection. Production ProtectionReason has no diagnostic-string conversion; legacy fixture conversions exist only under cfg(test). In the production protection module, adding a reason variant without an explicit source_role decision fails exhaustiveness checking; this requires a decision, not proof that the new decision is correct.
